rows.notes: The document is labelled 'TYPE Review' and is a narrative/bibliometric review of UAV remote sensing and deep learning for crop disease and pest detection. Its only own activities are a VOSviewer keyword/author/country co-occurrence analysis of 13,738 Web of Science papers (Section 2) and an informal trial of GPT-4 on two apple-leaf images (Section 6.2, Figure 9), neither of which is a primary experiment on UAV surveillance improving disease diagnostics, treatment strategies or targeted agrochemical application. All results on detection accuracy (e.g., Calou et al. SVM 99.28%, Marin et al. LMT 91.5%, Xiao et al. RF 94.0%) are cited from other work. Claims about optimizing treatment and precision agrochemical application appear only as general statements in Sections 1, 3.3 and 5, not as own findings. Q1 is 'no', so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references and abbreviations). The study is a review with bibliometric analysis; it reports no primary field, laboratory or survey data on the claimed effect.
